WITH bucket AS (
  INSERT INTO performance_db.auth_login_attempts (email, window_started_at, failed_count, last_failed_at, updated_at)
  VALUES (
    'epe-throttle:verify-invite:{{ $json.safe_ip }}',
    now(),
    1,
    now(),
    now()
  )
  ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET
    failed_count = CASE
      WHEN auth_login_attempts.window_started_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
      THEN auth_login_attempts.failed_count + 1
      ELSE 1
    END,
    window_started_at = CASE
      WHEN auth_login_attempts.window_started_at > now() - interval '5 minutes'
      THEN auth_login_attempts.window_started_at
      ELSE now()
    END,
    last_failed_at = now(),
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING failed_count
)
SELECT
  it.id,
  it.token,
  it.expires_at,
  b.failed_count AS throttle_count
FROM bucket b
LEFT JOIN performance_db.invite_tokens it
  ON it.token = '{{ $json.token }}'
 AND it.expires_at > NOW()
